sources.entry: TimeScribe - Simple and free working time recording.

summary.one_liner: TimeScribe is a free, offline desktop app for macOS and Windows that tracks work hours, projects, app usage, and absences without accounts or cloud sync.
summary.what_it_does: It lets you start, pause, and stop a work timer with one click, and auto start or pause based on screen time and idle status. It tracks time on projects with descriptions, hourly rates, and billing calculations, and shows app usage split into work versus distractions. Users can visualize daily and weekly patterns and plan absences such as vacation, sick leave, and holidays. Data is stored locally in SQLite and can be exported as PDF, Excel, or CSV. A deep-link API (timescribe://start/work, timescribe://start/break, timescribe://stop) lets other tools control the timer.
use_cases: track billable hours for freelance clients
export time reports to PDF, Excel, or CSV
control a timer from scripts or launchers
how_to_run: Or download TimeScribe-setup.exe (Windows) or TimeScribe.dmg (macOS) from the latest release
Build from source: git clone the repo, cd timescribe, composer install, npm install
npm run build && php artisan native:build mac (or native:build win)
notable: Fully local: no cloud, no account, no registration
Deep-link API for controlling the timer from Shortcuts, Alfred, Raycast, AutoHotkey, or scripts
Auto start/pause based on screen time and idle status
Multi-language UI including right-to-left Arabic and Hebrew
caveats: Arabic and Hebrew RTL text in PDF exports is not fully supported because Dompdf's complex text layout is incomplete
Windows build from source is marked 'coming soon or adjust accordingly' in the README
Only macOS and Windows are mentioned as supported platforms
